title: Matrix products, determinants and inverses
instructions:
## Two matrices

A = [[2, 1], [1, 3]] and B = [[1, 0], [4, 2]]. The **Matrices** tool multiplies, transposes, finds determinants and inverses. Work each answer by hand first, then confirm.

Enter matrices as rows separated by semicolons: `19 22; 43 50`. Fractions such as 3/5 are fine.

## Do this

Answer the questions on the right. For the last one, think about what the determinant says about an inverse.
hints: Row of A times column of B, entry by entry.
For a 2×2 matrix, swap the diagonal, negate the other two, divide by the determinant.
